  apply step1

import Mathlib
import Aesop

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem D_succ_eq (t : ℕ → ℕ) (K : ℕ) :
  (Finset.filter (fun i => i < (K + 1) ∧ t (i + 1) < t i) (Finset.range (K + 1))).card =
    (Finset.filter (fun i => i < K ∧ t (i + 1) < t i) (Finset.range K)).card +
      (if t (K + 1) < t K then 1 else 0) := by
  split_ifs with h
  case pos =>
    -- If t (K + 1) < t K, then the number of violations in [1, K + 1] is the number in [1, K] plus 1.
    simp_all [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
    <;>
    congr 1 <;>
    ext i <;>
    simp_all [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] <;>
    omega
  case neg =>
    -- If t (K + 1) ≥ t K, then the number of violations in [1, K + 1] is the same as in [1, K].
    simp_all [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
    <;>
    congr 1 <;>
    ext i <;>
    simp_all [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] <;>
    omega
